Document ID: service-register
Title: Service accountability register

Service accountability register, reviewed 9 October 2026.

Platform owns Beacon. Beacon delivers notifications for application teams; it is not itself a team or an approval role. Service ownership means operational accountability for reliability, access reviews and incident follow-up. It does not transfer customer refund approval rights.

The accountable team maintains the service runbook and decides how incident work is assigned. To identify its team lead, consult the leadership directory. On-call participation and team leadership are separate responsibilities. Application developers may contribute changes without becoming owners.
Document ID: leadership-directory
Title: Engineering leadership directory

Engineering leadership directory.

Elena Park leads Platform. The team covers service reliability, developer infrastructure and operational tooling. The leader is accountable for team planning; current on-call assignments are recorded in the incident rota.

Engineering team leads do not automatically hold finance approval roles. When investigating a service, start from its accountable team in the service register, then consult this directory. A service name and a person's informal project involvement are not sufficient to infer ownership.
Document ID: staffing-register
Title: Operations staffing register

Staffing register, updated 25 September 2026.

The Payments Lead role is held by Noah Chen. This appointment continues throughout 2026; temporary cover is recorded separately.

A role appointment identifies accountability, not attendance. When a holder is away, a separate cover notice determines who may exercise delegated authority. A person listed as available backup does not receive approval authority automatically.

The support queue has rotating coverage; the Support Agent role is shared across the roster. The staffing register is reviewed monthly and changes require an entry from operations. The payroll team uses a separate reporting structure. Do not infer refund authority from payroll reporting lines.
Document ID: weekly-notes
Title: Weekly operations notes

The operations team discussed queue backlog, reconciliation delays and the next onboarding batch. Several participants asked how to find approvers. The team agreed to link the customer handbook, staffing register and temporary cover notices from the support dashboard. These notes do not create new approval authority. Proposed changes to the threshold remain proposals until the handbook is revised. The dashboard should distinguish current rules from archived guidance so that search results do not silently mix the two.
